name: Evernote
description: Search, read, create, update, organize, share, and administer notes, notebooks, tags, resources, and saved searches through the Evernote Cloud API.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Relay-owned Evernote OAuth 1.0a, then let agents use selected Full Access capabilities under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions policy.

capabilities.label: Notebooks
capabilities.description: List and manage notebooks within the granted Evernote account.

capabilities.label: Notes
capabilities.description: Search, read, create, update, and delete notes and their resources.

capabilities.label: Full Evernote API
capabilities.description: Use documented Full Access NoteStore operations, including searches, sharing, resources, sync, and administration.

allowed.label: Read note
allowed.description: Read one note and optional ENML content.

approvalRequired.label: Create note
approvalRequired.description: Create a note with approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Update note
approvalRequired.description: Update a note with approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Delete note
approvalRequired.description: Move a note to trash with approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Evernote API
approvalRequired.description: Call another documented NoteStore operation with approval in Safe mode.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; mutations and the full NoteStore surface require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Evernote Full Access capability runs without Relay per-action approvals; ownership, provider authority, secret isolation, result bounds, rate limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Evernote tools and proxies the OAuth token server-side.
Railway mounts selected Evernote tools and proxies the OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must receive Evernote production activation for a Full Access API key and configure EVERNOTE_CONSUMER_KEY and EVERNOTE_CONSUMER_SECRET on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Submit the production Full Access activation justification, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/evernote/callback, and place the issued consumer credentials in Railway.

evidence.supports: Evernote uses three-legged OAuth 1.0a with temporary credentials, authorization, verifier callback, access-token exchange, and expiring user-selected token durations.
Full Access permits creating, reading, and updating notes, notebooks, tags, and shared notebooks; production activation requires justification.
NoteStore documents notes, notebooks, tags, resources, searches, sharing, sync, and other account operations.
Limits are per API key and user per time period; RATE_LIMIT_REACHED includes a retry duration and clients should avoid blind retry.
